properties.description:
EZ PERMIT SECURITY GATES & GRILLS - For the Installation of Security Gates & Grills as per attached standards. Deviations from these standards require submission of construction and site plans.

• EZ permit process shall not be applicable to buildings listed as historic as established by the Philadelphia Historical Commission. 
• All security gates & grills used for commercial purposes in Designated Center City, Historic, or Specified Neighborhood Commercial Areas (as specified in the Philadelphia Property Maintenance Code, Section PM803.1) shall allow for a minimum substantial front face visibility surface area openness of 75% at all times. 

• Installation of security gates/grills at main exits are permitted only in Group B, F, M and S occupancies. Gate/grill installed at main exits must be openable from the inside without the use of a key or special knowledge or effort during periods that the space is occupied. (B-1010.1.4.5) Note that the main exit(s) are identified as required exit(s) that are readily identifiable as a primary point of ingress and egress by building occupants. • Not more than 50% of the required exits or exit access doorways shall be equipped with horizontal or vertical sliding security grills. (B-1005.5) • Grills to remain secured in the full-open position during the period of occupancy by the general public. • Installation of new security gates/grills shall not obstruct egress path of other tenants, property owners or occupants at shared easements or entryways. (B-1010.1.4.5) 

• Minimum Height above Footway: 7’-0” Installation • Installation as per manufacturer’s specifications and listing. • Anchoring of security gates & grills shall be made to the front face of building with appropriate noncorrosive fasteners as per manufacturer’s instructions. • Complete manufacturer’s installation instructions to be on site for inspector. 

For the installation of one security gate to comply with the violation CF-2025-024445.
